title: Blast Circuit / Bach arcade playlist
rotation: Badinerie -> Neon Relay -> Foundry Rush -> Badinerie; continuous across arenas/rounds, 100 ms fades at track boundaries.

tracks.title: Badinerie / Circuit Mix
tracks.source_edition: Sam Franko, violin transcription, G. Schirmer, New York, 1911
tracks.source_rights: Sibley Music Library explicitly marks this item public domain.
tracks.transcription: Approved AABB melody and accompaniment preserved. Ornaments and tied articulations simplified, lead one octave lower.

tracks.title: Invention No. 8 / Neon Relay
tracks.source_edition: Bach-Gesellschaft; public-domain engraving by Allen Garvin, Mutopia-2008/06/15-61
tracks.source_rights: Mutopia lists Public Domain; LilyPond source includes the typesetter dedication.
tracks.transcription: All 34 bars, both contrapuntal parts at written pitch, twice with a stronger answering voice and percussion variation on the second pass. New 3/4 electronic groove.

tracks.title: Prelude in C minor / Foundry Rush
tracks.source_edition: Breitkopf & Hartel, 1866; public-domain engraving by Davide Castellone, Mutopia-2006/07/02-550
tracks.source_rights: Mutopia lists Public Domain; LilyPond source includes the typesetter dedication.
tracks.transcription: Driving passage, source bars 1–32, both parts at written pitch; repeated with percussion breakdown/build. Fixed 160 BPM instead of source tempo changes; later cadenza/Adagio omitted.

runtime: Integer sequencer, five bounded voices, shared original percussion/wavetables, stereo echo; no runtime MIDI, filesystem or external decoder.
